notes.title: Her Love, Like Poison has been released!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! I'm just making a quick post to let you know that my spooky yuri visual novel, [i]Her Love, Like Poison[/i], has been released!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/468de97559b15a5487765facaaccdfa38150a8b6.png[/img]

If you've read any of my other yuri VNs, then [i]Her Love, Like Poison[/i] might look familiar. The character art is by the same artist of my previously released yandere yuri visual novel, [i]It gets so lonely here[/i], and the UI is in a similar style.

I wrote [i]Her Love, Like Poison[/i] pretty soon after finishing up [i]Lonely[/i] (I must have been in the mood for more toxic yuri set in the woods), so while the two stories are unrelated, they might be a little bit similar tone-wise.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/46466091d3d03b8df4af805527fbf3963269452b.png[/img]

In any case, I hope you enjoy the story if you do check it out! It's quite a short game, so it's priced accordingly (it's $6.99 with a 10% launch discount).

You can pick it up here if you're interested:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3412620/

As always, thank you for your support over the years! It's very much appreciated!

- ebi x

notes.title: Chinese translation added
notes.content:
Hello everybody,

I'm making a quick post to let you know that I've uploaded a new build of Cage of Roses. This update adds a full Simplified Chinese translation to the VN, courtesy of the hardworking people at Yuri Atelier. Now, even more people should be able to enjoy this story!

I've also fixed a handful of typos which were present in the English script, so thank you to everybody who pointed those out.

As always, please let me know if you encounter more bugs or typos in this newest build of the game, and I will try to upload a new update when possible.

Thank you for all of your support so far. I'm very glad that this story has been so warmly received so far!

- ebi x

notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I'm writing a quick announcement to let you know that I've uploaded a new build of [i]Cage of Roses[/i]! This new build fixes a handful of typos which were pointed out to me by people on the Steam community forum, and some people in my Discord server.

Thank you all for your help; it's very much appreciated. Hopefully, the project should be even more polished now!

As always, if you find more typos in the game, or if you encounter any bugs or errors, please let me know. I will try to fix them when I am able!

- ebi
